name: OptimisticOfflineLock
summary: A conflict between two long transactions is detected at commit, by checking that nothing changed underneath.

roles.name: OptimisticOfflineLock
roles.summary: A record whose update is refused if it changed since it was read. It suits a system where conflicts are rare: nobody waits, and the cost is paid only by the loser — who must be told something useful, because a conflict discovered at save is work already done.

roles.name: VersionField
roles.summary: The member the check is made against — a version, a timestamp, a hash. Naming it matters because everything rests on it: an update that forgets to include it in its WHERE clause silently turns the whole pattern off, and nothing fails.
